provisional_features.gap_summary: No gap in the assigned evidence: Approval and successor-version transitions are explicit.

provisional_features.title: Preserved-source and extraction ownership contract is strong

provisional_features.gap_summary: No gap in the assigned evidence: Untrusted-source authority boundary is explicit.

provisional_features.gap_summary: No gap in the assigned evidence: Conflict authority and approval compatibility are deterministic.

provisional_features.title: PDS-010 lacks migration transaction and crash-recovery semantics
provisional_features.summary: Validated packet observation: PDS-010 names required artifacts and pilot gating but does not define run locking, artifact versioning, idempotent resume, atomic commit order, post-edit failure rollback, stale-run handling, retention, or operator-visible recovery state.

provisional_features.title: PDS-014 leaves deterministic identity and concurrent closure writes underspecified

provisional_features.title: PDS-015 reference-scan completion is not fully falsifiable
provisional_features.summary: Validated packet observation: PDS-015 requires scan results but does not define the authoritative document universe, term/alias derivation, path and case normalization, treatment of generated artifacts, no-update/defer evidence schema, or a machine-falsifiable completeness oracle.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Observed gap evidence: missing_reference_scan_universe_and_evidence_schema: PDS-015 reference-scan completion is not fully falsifiable.

provisional_features.title: PDS-016 lacks a concrete plan-pack reconciliation protocol
provisional_features.summary: Validated packet observation: PDS-016 lists extensive readiness dimensions and traceability sources but does not define Topic Plan Draft and Final Plan Pack schemas, lifecycle states, conflict-resolution precedence, Overseer authority, partial-failure recovery, amendment propagation, or acceptance receipts for reconciliation.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Observed gap evidence: missing_plan_pack_artifact_and_reconciliation_lifecycle_contract: PDS-016 lacks a concrete plan-pack reconciliation protocol.

provisional_features.title: PDS-017 permits retired authority to remain consumable
provisional_features.summary: Validated packet observation: PDS-017 allows either exclusion or labeling, but it does not define a fail-closed consumption rule for labeled retired content, transitive/alias matching, cache invalidation, retrieval provenance, or runtime behavior when the exclusion contract is unavailable or stale.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Observed gap evidence: fail_open_retired_retrieval_policy: PDS-017 permits retired authority to remain consumable.

provisional_features.title: PDS-018 leaves import adjudication non-executable
provisional_features.summary: Validated packet observation: PDS-018 identifies unresolved import classes but does not specify the adjudication record shape, row identity, allowed dispositions, decision authority, completeness count after splits/merges, failure behavior, or validator that gates canonical writes.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Observed gap evidence: missing_import_adjudication_artifact_and_oracle: PDS-018 leaves import adjudication non-executable.

provisional_features.title: PDS-019 omits authoritative blocker transition semantics
provisional_features.summary: Validated packet observation: PDS-019 defines registry fields and blocker families but not the complete status enum and legal transitions, who may accept risk, required approval/evidence for each transition, reopen and supersession rules, concurrent-write protection, audit history immutability, or GUI behavior during inconsistent registry/report states.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Observed gap evidence: missing_blocker_state_machine_and_risk_acceptance_authority: PDS-019 omits authoritative blocker transition semantics.

provisional_features.title: PDS-020 preserves the executable-proof boundary
provisional_features.summary: Validated packet observation: PDS-020 explicitly confines non-executable closure and preserves runtime_lifecycle, clean_room_harness, and overall buildability as open pending executable receipts.
provisional_features.gap_summary: No gap in the assigned evidence: PDS-020 preserves the executable-proof boundary.

provisional_features.summary: Validated packet observation: PDS-020 requires closure_evidence_refs but does not state who is authorized to close each family, whether references bind content hashes and schema versions, how registry and evidence updates are committed atomically, when changed owner inputs reopen closure, or how concurrent closure attempts recover.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Observed gap evidence: missing_closure_authority_and_evidence_snapshot_binding: PDS-020 closure evidence is not immutably or authoritatively bound.

provisional_features.title: Ledger authority is explicitly bounded

provisional_features.gap_summary: No gap in the assigned evidence: Ledger authority is explicitly bounded.

provisional_features.title: Bootstrap-native migration remains under-specified
provisional_features.summary: Validated packet observation: Import/export compatibility is required, but the PlanUnit does not define version negotiation, identity-collision policy, downgrade behavior, or a round-trip equivalence test.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Observed gap evidence: migration_versioning_and_equivalence_oracle_missing: Bootstrap-native migration remains under-specified.

provisional_features.title: Cold source shards lack a data lifecycle
provisional_features.summary: Validated packet observation: The cold-source role is clear, but its privacy lifecycle and destructive-action semantics are absent.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Observed gap evidence: cold_history_retention_and_erasure_contract_missing: Cold source shards lack a data lifecycle.

provisional_features.title: Operating-capsule permissions have no enforcement semantics
provisional_features.summary: Validated packet observation: Allowed and forbidden surfaces are named, but capsule authenticity, path validation, enforcement failure, and violation observability are not specified.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Observed gap evidence: capsule_permission_enforcement_contract_missing: Operating-capsule permissions have no enforcement semantics.

provisional_features.title: Exact preservation conflicts with safe data handling
provisional_features.summary: Validated packet observation: The exact-preservation obligation has no exception and provenance contract for secrets, personal data, or adversarial source content.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Observed gap evidence: exact_preservation_redaction_policy_missing: Exact preservation conflicts with safe data handling.

provisional_features.title: Planning Wizard and Goal integration lacks failure semantics
provisional_features.summary: Validated packet observation: The integration boundary is stated, but invocation identity, cancellation, retry, partial success, and visible failure-state propagation are not defined.
provisional_features.gap_summary: Observed gap evidence: goal_integration_failure_state_contract_missing: Planning Wizard and Goal integration lacks failure semantics.
